subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should Discord and Telegram adopt model preambles as an always-on progress headline and expose the three new progress lifecycle hooks through the public GetReplyOptions plugin contract?
rationale: The branch changes default cross-channel UX and expands a compatibility-sensitive plugin API; tests can establish mechanics but cannot decide whether these are the intended permanent product and extension contracts.

options.title: Approve after repairs and proof
options.body: Accept the proposed default headline and plugin API after the three lifecycle defects are fixed and exact-head Telegram evidence is published.

options.title: Land the gate-only fix
options.body: Keep the five-second time gate and narration deferral but defer the headline behavior and public lifecycle API to a separately approved change.

options.title: Keep existing contracts
options.body: Reject the always-on headline and new plugin API while retaining the current commentary opt-in behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve after repairs and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed default headline and plugin API after the three lifecycle defects are fixed and exact-head Telegram evidence is published.
